summary: Rework the local UI after owner feedback: add a home dashboard, frosted-glass styling, animations, clickable cards opening a full-abstract detail sheet, a background refresh job with progress polling, persisted AI summaries, and a detail API. Root-causes two reported bugs: the 'slow' generation was a single-threaded server blocked by the in-flight refresh (build_batch is 71ms), and 'incomplete abstracts' were a CSS clamp, not missing data.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 005e865. Server/service/db + static UI + tests; no model call in this unit.

budget_impact.rationale: UI/UX and server-concurrency work only; no model call and no budget/config change. The model path is unchanged and still goes through app/gateway.py.
budget_impact.before: Single-threaded server that blocked on refresh; card list only, truncated abstracts, dry-run shown as degradation.
budget_impact.after: Threaded server with per-request App; background refresh jobs; home dashboard, frosted glass, animations, full-abstract detail sheet, persisted summaries.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: Refresh runs in a background job; /api/home returned in 4ms while it ran

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; UI/UX and concurrency work, not recommendation quality

open_risks: Recommendation quality still unproven; E-RANKING/E-FEEDBACK-VALUE/E-LLM-LABEL-VALIDITY remain not_run.
OpenAlex 429s can still make refresh fetch nothing (now visible and non-blocking).
AI follow-up questions, notes/highlights, Zotero import and Tauri packaging remain unimplemented.
